profile.migration_strategy_justification: A no-login role that owns only workflow registry objects gives the inherited runtime role the same DDL authority healthy tenants already have, without granting broad database-admin membership.

invariants: The workflow registry tables and every row remain unchanged.
The ownership role cannot log in or administer databases, roles, replication, or row-level security.
The database runtime owner inherits the narrow registry ownership role and can run legacy boot DDL.
attestation.residual_risk_notes: The migration refuses unknown owners, creates one no-login role with no elevated attributes, grants it only to the admin actor and database runtime owner, transfers only workflow registry objects, and preserves all rows and schema shape.
